## generateUniqueDashedIdent() function

A generated dashed ident.

Generated names are stable for a given generator namespace and source namespace so that separate builds produce the same output.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function generateUniqueDashedIdent(generatorNamespace: string, sourceNamespace: string, increment: string): string;
```
